name: Christian Adler
headline: Enterprise Intelligence for Compliance, Marketing and more | BCG, CDTM, LMU, UC Berkeley, Leuphana Alumnus | 🇪🇺 Munich & Stockholm
summary:
Christian is a leading expert in AI & Digital Transformation. As Co-Founder of LoopID, he enables companies to increase conversion, loyalty and sustainability of their products via AI. LoopID’s AI-powered solutions include AI-Agents for customer engagement at point-of-sales and for the use-phase, Digital Product Passports and more.  

Prior to founding LoopID, Christian worked as Associate Director for AI & Digital Transformation at the Boston Consulting Group, where he build and led BCG’s digital offering.

Christian has studied Computer Science and Technology Management at the University of Munich (LMU), the Center for Digital Technology & Management (CDTM), and the University of California, Berkeley, as well as in Circular Economy at the Leuphana University.

positions.title: CIRPASS Textile & Electronics working group expert
positions.description:
Member of the expert working groups for Textile and Electronics, supporting the development of delegated acts under the ESPR (Ecodesign for Sustainable Product Regulation) with focus on Digital Product Passports, their standardization, interoperation and functionality.
With 13 lighthouse pilots, the CIRPASS-2 project will demonstrate functioning DPPs in real settings and at scale in four target value chains: textiles, electrical and electronic equipment, tyres and construction materials.
